## Sample distribution by region and age

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

sample_counts <- tribble(
  ~age_group,    ~Hippocampus, ~DLPFC,
  "Prenatal",    15,           17,
  "Infant",       3,            4,
  "Child",        5,            6,
  "Adolescent",   3,            3,
  "Adult",        6,            5
)

# Keep the age groups in developmental order.
plot_data <- sample_counts |>
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_group)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Hippocampus, DLPFC),
    names_to = "brain_region",
    values_to = "n_samples"
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = age_group, y = n_samples, fill = brain_region)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental age group",
    y = "Number of tissue samples",
    fill = "Brain region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 17)
```

32 of 67 tissue samples are prenatal.\
Each donor–region combination is counted once.

## Matched donors across regions

30 of 37 donors contributed samples from both brain regions.


| Developmental stage | Matched donor pairs |
|:--------------------|--------------------:|
| Prenatal            | 15 |
| Infant              |  2 |
| Child               |  5 |
| Adolescent          |  3 |
| Adult               |  5 |


Each pair compares both regions within th same donor.
